name: folex
input: • Do not exceed 2 ½ pints/A/Year of FOLEX 6 EC for California and Arizona, and 1 ½ pints/A/Year for all other states.

name: dropp
input: Additionally, do not apply Dropp® SC by air within one-half (1/2) mile of lettuce.

name: prep
input: Add 1/2 to 3/4 of the required amount of water to the spray tank. Start agitation. Add the required amount of PREP™ brand Ethephon for Cotton and Tobacco, and the remaining amount of water.

name: osprey
input: Do not apply when wind speeds exceed 10 miles per hour at the application site.

name: axial
input: Do not apply when wind speeds exceed 15 mph at the application site.
